items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: I got all of those things from, from Mitch Miller and all. I already knew them before Mitch Miller did, I guess.

ctx.x: But the majority of them. Let's show it to Pam to give her some idea of how many you know. The large majority, nearly all of those he knows. Out of a thousand too. Yeah, nearly every one.

Then I played ten years for Shakey's Pizza Parlor. I had to learn all of those old sing-along things. And I got all of those things from, from Mitch Miller and all. I already knew them before Mitch Miller did, I guess. I mean, we all learned them at the same time. And I've got all of those in the original record envelopes. You remember how he used to, they used to sell the records with the names of the tunes on the back of the, of the, of the envelope, the big pasteboard. I got all of those envelopes.
Mm-hmm. Well that was smart. That's a. Sure.
